message.content:
Based on my search, Jay Ellis's height is reported differently across sources:

- **6 feet 3½ inches (191.8 cm)** - according to Celeb Heights (as cited by one source)
- **6 feet 2½ inches (189 cm)** - according to Who's Dated Who
- **6 feet 2 inches** - according to MrDustbin.com
- **Almost 6 feet, 3 inches** - according to BET

The most commonly cited height appears to be around **6 feet 2½ to 6 feet 3½ inches**, with the Celeb Heights measurement of **6'3½"** being the most specific figure from a dedicated height-tracking source.

Sources:
1. https://sfp.mlga.ek.gov.ng/how-tall-is-the-insecure-actor-and-5-facts-about-him.html
2. https://www.whosdatedwho.com/dating/jay-ellis
3. https://www.bet.com/photo-gallery/xy9a84/jay-ellis-is-in-the-game/gej1ge
4. https://www.mrdustbin.com/us/jay-ellis/
